findings.namedBuyers: Nadja Burkhardt is the strongest operational accommodation contact: FEI 2026 schedules name her for NF/athlete room requests and hotel/showground shuttles. Sophie Mottu Morel is Directrice Générale on the organizing committee page and Event Director in the FEI schedule: relevant for supplier relationships and future partnership escalation. Frédérique De Lint is Sécrétariat général & VIP / General Secretary: relevant for routing VIP/organizer requirements. Their relevance is documented, but hotel contracting authority or ability to add another hotel is not established.
findings.futureEdition: CONFIRMED UPCOMING: the public centenary/65th edition runs 9–13 December 2026, not an article-publication date. Palexpo and the organizer agree. Exact venue: Palexpo, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland; Geneva Airport corridor, not Founex/La Côte and not central Geneva. The FEI administrative schedule spans 8–13 December and athlete accommodation starts 8 December; public competitions start 9 December. Separately, the regional equestrian federation FER lists CHI Genève for 8–12 December 2027 at Palexpo, with a Swiss Equestrian calendar link. Treat that as a federation-calendar listing, not a verified organizer venue contract: publication timing and organizer confirmation were not established. The organizer explicitly refers to its 66th edition in 2027 but no exact 2027 dates were found on its own pages. No exact 2028 edition dates established.
findings.hotelProductFit: INFERENCE using supplied hotel facts: YOTEL Geneva Lake is a possible secondary accommodation base for a specifically requested athlete-support, accompanying-party or other organizer-referred subgroup, not the host venue or primary housing solution. Its Founex/La Côte location requires a separately agreed transfer solution to Palexpo. The published official-hotel shuttle does not establish a YOTEL stop. Any exploratory proposal should stay within the supplied 20–120-room guidance and actual hotel availability; this is sales sizing, not published event demand. The 237 guestrooms and six meeting rooms could support a small ancillary briefing only if a real requirement emerges; the sporting arena is entirely unsuitable for relocation into this hotel. No banquet/catering capacity or resort-retreat requirement is established. Do not pitch primary housing for the eventwide spectator audience.
findings.venueCommitments: 2026 venue confirmed at Palexpo by the venue listing and organizer programme; it is an exhibition arena, not a competing hotel. The FEI schedule identifies Geneva Cointrin airport and Geneva Airport railway station as approximately 15 minutes on foot from the showground. This is an airport-corridor event, not a Lausanne or French-border event. Future venue-contract term or relocation tender is not published in the reviewed evidence.
findings.historicalRotation: A Geneva-based event with historical local venue moves, not a demonstrated rotating destination congress. Official history places it at the former Palais des Expositions in 1926–1936 and 1947–1973, Plainpalais in 1946, Les Vernets in 1975–1989, and Palexpo since 1991. Recent 2024 and 2025 editions remained at Palexpo. Annual recurrence is explicitly stated by Palexpo ("Chaque année, à Palexpo"); centenary means 100 years since foundation in 1926, not the 100th edition. The 2026 show is the 65th.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Organizer-managed accommodation with an established incumbent, not an evidenced open RFP. EVERY named hotel found in the reviewed 2026 public accommodation page, brochure and jumping/eventing/driving schedules: Geneva Marriott Hotel only. The edition-specific French page calls it "Geneva Marriott, l’hôtel du CHI de Genève" and directs accommodation questions to accommodation@chi-geneve.ch. This is supported by actual athlete housing provisions, not merely a preferred-hotel advertisement. The jumping schedule names Geneva Marriott and states "Accommodated (bed and breakfast) from 08/12/2026 to 13/12/2026" and "At the expense of the Organiser" for CSI5* athletes. It also says "hotel rooms will not be booked automatically": NF/athlete written requests go to Mrs Nadja Burkhardt by Friday 20 November 2026. Accompanying parties use the same email/phone before 20 November; U25 athletes and grooms submit accommodation requests with entries at their own expense. Eventing provision is 10–12 December; driving provision is 10–13 December, including two double rooms per team (one driver room and one room for two grooms). These are category-specific provisions, not eventwide room totals. Eventing wording also says "before 21th of November" in logistical entries; its detailed athlete section specifies Friday 20 November and grooms/accompanying parties before 20 November. No external housing bureau, open procurement, numerical hotel allocation or current inventory availability was established.
findings.organizationStructure: The official committee page identifies Association du CHI de Genève (ACHIG), with Thierry Naz as president and Guillaume Mottu as vice-president, plus a separate organizing committee led operationally by Sophie Mottu Morel. Palexpo lists Concours Hippique International de Genève as organizer and supplies the venue; do not substitute Palexpo as the accommodation buyer. The reviewed sources show an association-led sports event, not a travel-trade intermediary, PCO or DMC. No external PCO/DMC sourcing mandate was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Geneva Marriott is both the edition-specific official hotel and the named athlete accommodation hotel. Its promotion on the event site states 263 rooms and suites; that is hotel stock, NOT the CHI room allocation. The FEI schedule confirms an organizer shuttle and says hotel/showground walking distance is not available; no YOTEL transfer inclusion is documented. Neither historical spectator attendance nor sold-out ticket sessions proves a lodging shortage. No sourced evidence of hotel sell-out, rejected bookings, spillover to La Côte, unfilled supplementary blocks or an overflow RFP was found. Organizer-arranged extra nights at athlete expense are extensions, not evidence of overflow inventory.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Nadja Burkhardt promptly, before the published 20 November participant accommodation deadline, with a short introduction to the Founex property and ask whether any specific 2026 accompanying-party/support-team requirement remains outside existing allocations; request arrival/departure, rooms per night, budget, paymaster and acceptable transfer arrangements before pricing. Do not offer an assumed block. If fully allocated, request a post-event conversation with Sophie Mottu Morel about becoming an approved supplementary hotel for the next edition and ask for the supplier review window and incumbent/exclusivity boundaries. Keep 2026 tactical availability separate from future capture; no open RFP is evidenced.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: LOW / CONDITIONAL as of 17 November 2026. The 9–13 December event is upcoming, but core athlete accommodation already has a named incumbent and organizer-controlled booking pathway. The 20 November request deadline creates a timely reason to ask Nadja whether supplementary needs exist; it is NOT a hotel-supplier tender deadline or proof that hotel sourcing is open. Do not displace centrally managed rider/groom accommodation or describe all spectator lodging as centrally contracted: the evidence specifically establishes the participant pathways and a general accommodation inquiry route, not all visitor bookings.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: INFERENCE: prioritize a future approved secondary-hotel relationship over replacing Palexpo or the incumbent rider hotel. Verified annual recurrence, long-term Palexpo use and the organizer’s explicit 2027/66th-edition reference support relationship development. FER separately lists 8–12 December 2027 at Palexpo; confirm organizer dates, housing scope and procurement timing before treating that listing as a committed commercial opportunity. No 2027 hotel tender, incumbent expiry, uncontracted room demand or capture probability is published.
